data.narrative:
Voyant Photonics is a Series A chip design company founded by Chris Phare and Steven Miller, having raised $23M to date. The valuation exercise triangulates the target against 3 private peers in Chips & Semiconductors (Rebellions, d-Matrix, Positron AI) at comparable or adjacent stages, alongside a public comp universe of 3 semiconductor leaders (ALAB, NVDA, AMD).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression anchors to the $23M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a typical 2.0x multiplier for advancement to Series B, implying $46M. Peer-median uses the 3-company sample, which spans $1.0B to $2.3B with a median of $2.0B, reflecting recent market pricing for semiconductor IP at Voyant's stage. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because Voyant does not disclose revenue; the semiconductor sector median P/S of 18.9x therefore remains unusable.

The two applicable methods produce a wide range. Stage-progression yields $46M; peer-median yields $2.0B. The triangulated low is $39M, median $1.0B, and high $2.3B. This dispersion reflects fundamental uncertainty: whether Voyant's current valuation should rest on capital deployed or on recent private-market comps for functionally similar companies. Resolution will likely depend on differentiation in technology, team track record, and customer traction—factors not quantified in available data.
